summary: Int-Opposed. Hide while standing still; you become invisible to Mobs and HUDs.

name: Improvised Explosive Device

5.text: Your crafting takes half the time.

10.text: Your devices deal d10s of damage instead of d6s (the default).

15.text: Your devices can be set to trigger only against a specific Mob, Boss, NPC, or crawler.

summary: Unopposed. Build bombs and traps without a Sapper's Table.

name: Incendiary Device Handling

5.text: You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materials of incendiary devices you handle.

10.text: You are able to craft incendiary devices as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have incendiary raw materials and a Sapper’s Table. See

15.text: Add a +5 Splash to your crafted device at no additional Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.

summary: Unopposed. Handle incendiary devices safely.

name: Infusion
limitations: Requires an Infusion Station attachment on an Alchemy Table or Tier 3 Sapper’s Table.

5.text: One potion can infuse 2 items at once.

10.text: One potion can infuse 5 items at once.

15.text: One potion can infuse 10 items at once.

summary: Put a potion's effect into a consumable item.

name: Intimidate

5.text: On Success or greater, until the end of the next round, the target can only use its remaining Actions to move away from you (though it does not need to use its Step when doing so).

10.text: The target also gains the Woozy Debuff.

15.text: The target drops everything they were holding and also gains the Paralyzed Debuff.

summary: Cha-Opposed. Scare a foe so it becomes Staggered.

name: Investigation

5.text: If you’re familiar with the area you are investigating, you can make the Skill Check with Advantage.

10.text: Each attempt takes 5 minutes.

15.text: Roll with Advantage if you know the parties involved. Example: You know the puzzle’s maker, or you know the murder victim and the main suspect.

summary: Unopposed, 10 minutes. Learn something useful; also for Look for Clues.

name: Iron Stomach

5.text: On a Critical Hit, gain 1 additional permanent Intelligence.

10.text: On a Standard Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence. You may eat cursed items with no ill effects.

15.text: You choose which Stat is permanently increased.

summary: Unopposed. Eat magic items (Amazing Success: +1 permanent Int).

name: Jumping

5.text: Add your Dexto the height of your Jump.

10.text: You gain a +1 Evade Buff.

15.text: Your leap distance in feet is Rank + [Str ×2].

summary: Unopposed. Running leap of up to Rank + Str feet.

name: Leadership

5.text: You may instead use this Skill during Skill challenges while on a group Quest. Perform a free Call a Play Action, and it extends to each member of the parties during their next non-combat Skill Check.

10.text: Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Move Action.

15.text: Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Evade Action.

summary: Int-Opposed. Coordinate parties so they get Advantage on their first attack against a Boss.

name: Light on Your Feet
limitations: Usable only by animals

5.text: Your distance is Rank ×3 and your height is Dex ×3.

10.text: You may leap without an arcing trajectory, which allows for “straight up.”

15.text: Your leap may last up to your Rank in seconds, which resembles gliding.

summary: Unopposed. Running leap of Rank ×2 feet, reaching Dex ×2 feet high.

name: Lockpicking
limitations: Roll with Disadvantage if you do not have the proper tools, unless it’s a crude lock.

5.text: You make no noise and leave no trace.

10.text: Each attempt takes half the time. You may alter the lock so that the key no longer works.

15.text: You don’t roll with Disadvantage if you lack the proper tools.

summary: Unopposed, takes Floor-number minutes. Pick a lock.

name: Lore

5.text: You can identify the major factions in the area.

10.text: You are aware of the important local NPCs. Just give your GM a break and don’t demand this all up front or the first one you come across will likely attack you.

15.text: You roll with Advantage on your first Charisma-based Skill Check when encountering an organized group in a neighborhood.

summary: Unopposed. Know something about a neighborhood, its Mobs or its locals.

name: Negotiation
limitations: Does not work on members of your own party. Some items have a minimum price.

5.text: Your party members can also buy or sell at your newly-negotiated price.

10.text: Increase or decrease the price by an additional 10% in your favor.

15.text: Increase or decrease the price by an additional 15% in your favor.

summary: Int-Opposed, 5 minutes. Haggle prices with merchants.

name: Pathfinder
limitations: Ranks in this Skill only increase by magical means and training.

5.text: You are notified when you are near a saferoom or stairwell.

10.text: You can see through your map while it is open in your HUD.

15.text: Mobs appear as red dots on your HUD map.

summary: Your HUD map covers Rank × the normal area.

name: Perception

5.text: Halve the penalty for cluttered areas.

10.text: Halve the penalty for how short of a window you have to notice the thing.

15.text: Halve the penalty for the range to the thing.

summary: Unopposed. Notice details; also for Look for Clues.

name: Performance

5.text: Choose an additional type of performance to specialize in.

10.text: Choose an additional type of performance. You can coach and coordinate others in one of your specialties. After coaching them for at least 1 hour in one of your specialties, they can attempt an unskilled Performance Skill Check without Disadvantage.

15.text: Choose an additional type of performance. You can mimic someone else’s performance after experiencing it once.

summary: Unopposed. Wow an audience in your specialty.

name: Persuasion

5.text: They’ll follow your suggestion even if it is costly for them.

10.text: They’ll follow your suggestion even if it is dangerous.

15.text: They’ll follow your suggestion even if it’s against their nature.

summary: Int-Opposed, about 10 minutes. Convince someone to go along with you.

name: Regeneration

5.text: After 5 minutes, any Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 10 minutes, any Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends.

10.text: After 20 minutes, any Long-Term Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 1 hour, any Long-Term Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends.

15.text: The time required to end injury Debuffs is halved.

summary: Heal 1 slot every round if Rank ≥ your Con, otherwise every other round.

name: Religion

5.text: You can identify the followers on sight, even if they’re trying to hide their affiliation.

10.text: You know how to sow discord among the followers of that religion.

15.text: You know strengths and weakness of the gods.

summary: Unopposed. Know the basics about a god and its followers.

name: Repair
limitations: For basic repairs to items with no moving parts, magical or not.

5.text: You can make repairs to things with moving parts.

10.text: You can make repairs in 1 hour.

15.text: You can rebuild a destroyed item.

summary: Unopposed, 2 hours. Fix a broken item.

name: Riding
limitations: The rider in control of the mount rolls Attack Skill Checks with Disadvantage.

5.text: Your mount has +5ft Move. You no longer suffer Disadvantage when attacking while Riding.

10.text: Your mount has an additional +10ft Move. When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).

15.text: Your mount has an additional +15ft Move. When performing crazy stunts (like jumping through flames), roll with Advantage.

summary: Stay on a panicking mount during action scenes.

name: Ropework

5.text: You can now use this Skill as an Attack, at a Range of 10ft vs. the target’s Evade. On Success, the target gains the Held Debuff.

10.text: You can whip your line in that special way to untie a knot you made and recover your rope.

15.text: Your Attack now has a Range of your Strength (min 15). Just make sure your rope is long enough.

summary: Unopposed. Knots, lassos and tying things up.

name: Running
limitations: For short bursts of running. For extended runs, use Endurance instead (p. 190).

5.text: You have a permanent +5ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 2 minutes.

10.text: You have an additional permanent +10ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 4 minutes.

15.text: You have an additional permanent +15ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 6 minutes.

summary: Unopposed, each minute. Races and chases (+1 per 10ft Move).

name: Salvage
limitations: Salvage cannot be used with explosive devices.

5.text: Your Salvage Checks take 30 minutes.

10.text: On Success, you recover all of the important raw materials.

15.text: On a crafting Standard Fail or Near Miss, roll your crafting Check again with Advantage, with an additional 15-minute time expenditure.

summary: Unopposed, 1 hour. Recover half the materials from wrecked or failed crafts.

name: Scutelliphily
limitations: This Limited Skill can only be learned via a Race, Class, or item.

5.text: You can sew and iron patches onto clothing using this Skill.

10.text: You may use this as a crafting Skill, but crafting tables provide no bonuses. Enchanted patches are limited to one per Gear slot and do not take up Accessory slots. See Crafting, p. 221.

15.text: Your crafting Checks take half the time. Increase the bonus value of your enchantments with this Skill by 1, at no additional Difficulty or time to craft.

summary: Unopposed. Identify patches and improve the patches you craft.

name: Shield Block
limitations: Requires you to be wielding a shield. Cannot be used against Area of Effect damage. A successful Shield Block still counts as “a hit crawler” or “a crawler who failed to Evade.”

5.text: You may also use this Skill against Spells and magical damage.

10.text: On a Critical Hit, you may make a Shield Bash Attack as a free melee-range Interrupt Attack (instead of Advantage on your next Attack) if you wish, dealing 3d6 base damage + Str Bludgeoning.

15.text: +1d6 Shield Bash damage. Further reduce the damage you would take by your Str Mod. Example: After halving 30 damage down to 15, your Str Mod of 5 reduces it to 10 damage.

summary: Interrupt: roll against each physical attack's to-hit to block it with a shield.

name: Sleight of Hand
limitations: Items you manipulate must be smaller than the size of your hand. You cannot access others’ Inventories or Hotlists.

5.text: You may attempt to pick the pockets of NPCs and Mobs.

10.text: You may attempt to plant items on someone with pockets or the equivalent.

15.text: You may manipulate items up to half your own size (rounded down).

summary: Int-Opposed. Move small objects without being noticed.

name: Smithing

5.text: You may craft items up to a +5 bonus.

10.text: You may craft items up to a +10 bonus.

15.text: Your crafting with this Skill takes half the time.

summary: Forge mundane metal items, weapons and armor.

name: Stealth
limitations: You must be out of sight of all foes to begin this Check.

5.text: Your surprise Action can be an Attack with Advantage.

10.text: When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).

15.text: On a successful Surprise Check, you may also take a full Move and Step. If you Attack with your Surprise Action, deal ×2 the base damage dice.

summary: Int-Opposed. Move unseen; before combat, gain a free non-Attack Action.

name: Streetwise

5.text: You also hear an additional rumor, as determined by the GM. Or spread one!

10.text: You also quickly find a hiding place determined by the GM.

15.text: You also uncover information that might give you some leverage on an important person in town determined by the GM.

summary: Unopposed. Rumors, black markets and keeping a low profile in town.

name: Survival

5.text: You do not suffer additional damage from a Critical Fail.

10.text: When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).

15.text: You do not suffer additional damage from a Major Fail.

summary: Unopposed. Get through harsh, remote areas unharmed.

name: Swimming
limitations: After 1 minute of Swimming (Success or Fail) or immediately on a Major Fail or worse, gain the Fatigued Debuff.

5.text: After 2 minutes of Swimming (Success or Fail), gain the Fatigued Debuff.

10.text: You can swim at your full Move rate as an Action, but you still can’t take a 10ft Step.

15.text: Make this Check every 5 minutes, and only gain the Fatigue Debuff on a Critical Fail.

summary: Unopposed, every 30 seconds. Swim under pressure; causes Fatigue.

name: Tactics
limitations: A crawler may attempt this Skill Check only once per combat.

5.text: If you observe the foes and battlefield for at least 5 minutes prior to combat, roll this Skill Check with Advantage.

10.text: After using this Skill during a combat, you roll 2d10 when you Call a Play (still choose one die).

15.text: The bonus applies to all three combat disciplines instead of just one.

summary: Unopposed, once per combat. Party gets +1 or more to Attack, Damage or Evade.

name: Tattoo Artistry

5.text: You may craft tattoos with up to a +5 bonus.

10.text: You may craft tattoos with up to a +10 bonus.

15.text: Your crafting with this Skill takes half the time.

summary: Mundane tattoos (magical ones use crafting rules).

name: Taunt

5.text: You may make a free Evade Check against each Taunted Attack (roll separately vs. each Attack as usual). Then you may still spend an Action to Evade other Attacks and reroll any Fails from your free Evades.

10.text: You can affect Mobs within 60 feet.

15.text: Your free Evade Checks against Taunted Attacks are made with Advantage.

summary: Interrupt, Int-Opposed. Pull a Mob's attack onto yourself.

name: Throwing

5.text: You have Advantage when Throwing to a target who wants to catch what you are selling.

10.text: Choose the direction on a miss, rather than roll.

15.text: Your Throw range is your Str ×20 feet.

summary: Throw objects (Unopposed to hit an area, vs Evade to hit a foe); range Str ×10 ft.

name: Tracking

5.text: You can follow found tracks for 30 minutes before making a new Check, and gain 1 piece of information about the target(s).

10.text: You can follow found tracks for 1 hour before making a new Check, and gain 2 pieces of information about the target(s).

15.text: You can follow found tracks for 2 hours before making a new Check, and gain 4 pieces of information about the target(s).

summary: Unopposed. Find and follow tracks, re-rolling every 15 minutes.

name: Trap Engineer

5.text: Roll with Advantage when making non-explosive traps.

10.text: Your traps can be set to trigger only against a specific Mob, Boss, NPC, or crawler.

15.text: Add a +5 Splash to your trap at no additional Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.

summary: Craft traps with a Sapper's Table and Trap Module.

name: Zone of Control
limitations: You must be wielding a Reach weapon.

5.text: Your Attack is no longer made with Disadvantage.

10.text: The target is pushed 5 feet.

15.text: Make your Attack Skill Check with Advantage.

summary: Once per round, Interrupt-attack a foe entering an adjacent space (with Disadvantage).

name: Creepy Chains

5.text: +1d6 base damage

10.text: +1d6 base damage, and the target gains the Woozy Debuff.

15.text: +1d6 base damage, and if the target loses at least 3 Health Bar slots, they gain the Take Down Debuff.

summary: Changbi Demon racial chain weapon: works like a Club with 10ft reach.
